messages.subject: Re: NaN for estimated SE (both unstandardized and standardized)
parts: It looks like F3 is a higher order factor with two indicators. A two indicator factor is not typically identified unless an additional constraint is imposed (e.g. equality of factor loadings). Sometimes unidentified models will produce estimates and SEs for subsets of parameters, but I would not typically trust those.
